description: This header file declares a NetUtils class within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace. The class provides static utility functions for network-related operations such as IP address validation, executing commands, file retrieval, environment variable access, and interface description management. It includes necessary headers, defines constants, and declares private and public methods, along with relevant data members.

classes.name: NetUtils
classes.description: Provides utility functions for network interface and IP address management, process execution, environment variable retrieval, and file handling within the WPEFramework plugin context.

methods.name: InitialiseNetUtils
methods.description: Initializes network utilities, possibly loading interface descriptions.

methods.name: getInterfaceDescription
methods.description: Returns a description string for the specified network interface.

methods.name: isIPV4
methods.description: Checks if the provided address is a valid IPv4 address.

methods.name: isIPV6
methods.description: Checks if the provided address is a valid IPv6 address.

methods.name: isIPV6LinkLocal
methods.description: Checks if the IPv6 address is link-local.

methods.name: isIPV4LinkLocal
methods.description: Checks if the IPv4 address is link-local.

methods.name: execCmd
methods.description: Executes a command, captures output, and optionally indicates success and output file.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Reads the contents of a file into a string, with optional deletion.

methods.name: envGetValue
methods.description: Retrieves environment variable value for a given key.

methods.name: getTmpFilename
methods.description: Generates a temporary filename based on input.

methods.name: isValidEndpointURL
methods.description: Validates if a URL endpoint string is well-formed.

methods.name: _isCharacterIllegal
methods.description: Checks if a character is illegal in certain contexts.
